# Welcome

Brief welcome to the guided activity book.

# What this book is

This book contains the guided activity materials for learning R workflow.

# How to use this book

Open a chapter, work in RStudio, type the code, read the explanations, and use the activity to prepare for the Canvas Practice Space.

# What this book is not

This is not where students submit work. Canvas remains the place for Practice Space submissions, quizzes, and file uploads.
